messages:
ria: FYI onboarding harbinger-embed-v1 to staging. Ran quick similarity checks vs sentinel-v2 — seeing weird recall@1 drop on short queries.

aman: numbers?

ria: recall@1: sentinel 0.612 -> harbinger 0.569 (-4.3% abs). recall@10: 0.912 -> 0.901 (-1.1%). silhouette: 0.12 -> 0.05. small sample: 10k queries from prod-sampled-short.

sarah: hmm that's notable. was this with quantized weights or fp16?

ria: fp16 baseline. also did INT4 per-tensor quantization quick check: recall@1 worsened to 0.52. command used:
```
python eval_embeddings.py \
  --model harbinger-v1 \
  --dataset prod-short-10k \
  --pooling mean \
  --quant none \
  --seed 42
```

jon: any differences in tokenizer or pooling compared to sentinel?

ria: suspected pooling. harbinger default pooling=CLS while sentinel uses mean. reran mean-pool -> recall@1 0.59 (closer but still off). Also noticed l2 norms skewed: harbinger vec norms median=0.9 vs sentinel 1.02.

sarah: can you dump a few vectors and check normalization? maybe preprocessing mismatch (lowercase, strip punctuation)

ria: dumped sample, ran quick check:
```
np.percentile(np.linalg.norm(vecs,axis=1), [10,50,90]) => [0.72,0.90,1.05]
```

eval-bot: eval run completed: clustering_kmeans=50 -> harbinger purity 0.68 vs sentinel 0.75. tsne/umap preview: https://redwood-internal/plots/harbinger-4876549999.png

aman: try re-normalize after pooling and re-eval (L2). also try per-channel INT4 quant (we've seen that help on other models).

ria: will do. plan: 1) run mean+L2 norm fp16 2) mean+L2 perchannel-int4 3) check tokenizer char-level differences. assigning @sarah to review preprocessing. target finish EOD.

sarah: on it. I'll run a stratified holdout by query length too.

jon: If mean+L2 closes gap >=0.02 we'll consider pass with flag to normalize at serving. If not, escalate to model team for pooling/pooling-head mismatch.

ria: thanks. will post results as they come. :thumbsup:
